_readme: Fill in every value below ONCE, then run `npm run site`. Anything still containing YOUR or example is flagged by `npm run legal:check`, which also runs in `npm run release`.
developerName: YOUR LEGAL NAME OR COMPANY NAME
phone: YOUR PHONE NUMBER (needed for the EU trader listing, not published on these pages)
governingLaw: the laws of YOUR STATE OR COUNTRY
venue: the courts of YOUR CITY, STATE OR COUNTRY
hostingProvider: YOUR STATIC HOST (for example GitHub Pages)
